nodes.name: Galois group as functor on category of finite field extensions
nodes.statement: Inteperate Galois group as functors on $ \text{FinExt}_K $ satisfying certain property. Show that $\text{FinExt}_K \simeq \text{FinExt}_K'$ induces an isomorphism $\Gal_K \simeq \Gal_{K'}$.
nodes.statement_short: Plan: view the Galois group as a functor on finite extensions of $K$; an equivalence $\text{FinExt}_K \simeq \text{FinExt}_{K'}$ gives $\Gal_K \simeq \Gal_{K'}$.
nodes.label: Relate Galois Group with Category of Finite Field Extensions

nodes.name: Perfectoid Field
nodes.statement: Let $K$ be a topological field. We say that $K$ is a \emph{perfectoid field} if and only if the following conditions are satisfied:\\ (a) the topology on K is induced by a valuation $\| \cdot \| : K \to \R_{\ge0}$, and $K$ is complete for this topology;\\ (b) there exists a non-unit $\pi \in \O_K$ such that $p \in \pi^p \O_K$;\\ (c) every element of $\O_K/p\O_K$ is a $p$th-power.
differentia: the topology on K is induced by a valuation $\| \cdot \| : K \to \R_{\ge0}$, and $K$ is complete for this topology
there exists a non-unit $\pi \in \O_K$ such that $p \in \pi^p \O_K$
nodes.statement_short: A complete valued topological field with a non-unit $\pi$, $p\in\pi^p\O_K$, and surjective Frobenius on $\O_K/p$.
nodes.label: Perfectoid Field

nodes.name: Tilting Equivalence (Tilting Functor)
nodes.statement: There is an equivalence of category \begin{align*} (-)^\flat : \left \{ \text{Perfectoid fields over } K \right \} & \to \left \{ \text{Perfectoid fields over } K^\flat \right \} : (-)^\# \\ L & \mapsto L^\flat \end{align*}
nodes.section: 5 The Tilting Equivalence for Perfectoid Fields
conclusions: There is an equivalence of category \begin{align*} (-)^\flat : \left \{ \text{Perfectoid fields over } K \right \} & \to \left \{ \text{Perfectoid fields over } K^\flat \right \} : (-)^\# \\ L & \mapsto L^\flat \end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: Tilting $L \mapsto L^\flat$ is an equivalence between perfectoid fields over $K$ and over $K^\flat$, inverse untilt $(-)^\#$.
nodes.label: Tilting Functor

nodes.name: Untilt preserves degree
nodes.statement: Let $M$ be a finite extension of $K^\flat$. ($M$ is automatically a perfectoid field. add this theorem) Then its untilt $M^\#$ is of the same degree.
